name: webext-email-address-plus
description: Automatically generate labeled email addresses for better organization and spam protection. Adds website-specific labels to your email when filling forms.
author: kud

scripts.publish:
node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const changelog=fs.readFileSync('CHANGELOG.md','utf8'); const sections=changelog.split(/## \[/); const firstSection=sections[1]; const match=firstSection?firstSection.split(/
(?=## )/)[0]:''; const lines=match.split('
').slice(1); const notes=lines.join('
').trim(); fs.writeFileSync('.amo-metadata.json', JSON.stringify({release_notes:{en:notes}}, null, 2));" && web-ext sign --channel=listed --amo-metadata=.amo-metadata.json --source-dir .output/firefox-mv2 --upload-source-code .output/${npm_package_name}-${npm_package_version}-sources.zip
scripts.version:
node -e "const pkg=require('./package.json'); const fs=require('fs'); const changelog=fs.readFileSync('CHANGELOG.md','utf8'); const today=new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]; const newEntry='## ['+pkg.version+'] - '+today+'

### Changed
- Version bump

'; const headerMatch=changelog.match(/(# Changelog[\s\S]*?

)(?=## \[)/); if(headerMatch) { const header=headerMatch[1]; const rest=changelog.substring(headerMatch.index + headerMatch[1].length); const updated=header+newEntry+rest; fs.writeFileSync('CHANGELOG.md', updated); } else { console.error('Could not find changelog header'); } console.log('Updated CHANGELOG.md to version', pkg.version);" && git add CHANGELOG.md
